instruction: A clean studio portrait photograph, captured in a medium shot at eye-level with a shallow depth of field and blurred purple flowers in the foreground. In a minimalist indoor studio with a plain white background, three friends sit huddled closely together. On the left, the woman with wavy light brown hair (R3), wearing a white shirt over a black top, leans in with eyes closed and a peaceful smile. In the center, the woman with straight dark hair (R2), wearing a white high-neck top and denim jacket, smiles warmly. On the right, the woman with curly brown hair (R1), wearing a white shirt, smiles happily. The women on the left (R3) and right (R1) wrap their arms around the center woman (R2) in a warm group hug. The scene is illuminated by soft, bright studio lighting.
